items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: He was, also Salmon was with Pierron too.

ctx.x: Well do you know, when did he go with Pierron? He was in one picture I have he's playing with Arlen Pierron's band.
He was, also Salmon was with Pierron too.

You didn't know that did you? I don't remember, usually John Lindsay was playing bass or somebody else, he was playing combo too. Yeah yeah. I saw John's picture with Pierron, he didn't go to New York with Pierron did he? No. Early in the 20's to make it.
